IT Support Analyst (Co-op)

Company: Kestrel Municipal Services
Location: Saskatoon, SK
Work Arrangement: On-site
Work Term: Winter 2028
Duration: 4 or 8 months
Salary: $23.50 per hour
Application Deadline: 2027-09-30

About the Role

Kestrel Municipal Services provides shared technology services to small municipalities.
The IT Support Analyst will staff our internal help desk and support desktop imaging.

Responsibilities

- Triage help desk tickets and escalate infrastructure issues
- Support desktop imaging, patching, and hardware refresh cycles
- Maintain technical support documentation for end users

Students may be hired for either a 4 or 8 month work term depending on program
requirements.
